subject: Decision path & mutual action plan — MedSaaS next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <h.cole@medsaas.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + suggested decision path and MAP draft

Hi Hannah — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on our call so we’re all aligned. I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) — very lightweight, intended to serve as the shared milestone tracker.

Call highlights:
- Business driver: reduce per-query latency and predictable inference cost for MedSaaS’s patient-facing summarization flow.
- Primary decision criteria: latency under 120ms 95th, integration effort (SDK + webhooks), and unit economics vs. current GPU infra.
- Probable PoC scope: 3-week sandbox, 100k monthly test tokens, 1 endpoint for the summarizer + embeddings for reranking.

Stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: CFO (you said you’d confirm name)
- Security: Jamal (CISO) — we’ll send SOC2 excerpt and key controls; Jamal, cc’ing on this thread so you have the MAP draft.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@medsaas.com (please confirm owner for contract redlines).

Suggested next steps (ask of MedSaaS):
1) Confirm economic buyer and procurement/legal contact (by 2027-03-04).
2) Security: we’ll send SOC2 excerpt + short security Q&A; please let us know any additional evidence required (target 2027-03-08).
3) Approve MAP draft or suggest edits — once agreed we’ll lock milestone owners and dates (target 2027-03-05).

Action items for Redwood:
- Ben to own security evidence collection and share SOC2 excerpt (attached).
- Evelyn to prepare integration checklist and estimate for the PoC.

Attachments: MedSaaS-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-excerpt-2026.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to a short confirmation on the buyer/procurement owners so we can finalize dates.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai
From: Hannah Cole <h.cole@medsaas.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsaas.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + suggested decision path and MAP draft

Tessa — great summary, thank you. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer is confirmed: Lisa Park, CFO (lisa.park@medsaas.com). I’ve looped Lisa on the intro separately.
- Procurement: procurement@medsaas.com is the right inbox — I’ll introduce Ken (procurement lead) in a separate email today.
- Security: Jamal will own the security review, but he’ll likely ask for additional details beyond SOC2 (network diagram, data flow for PHI handling, and encryption in transit/storage). I’m attaching our procurement questionnaire; if you can fill the security section that speeds legal review.

Timeline we’re working to: CFO wants a recommendation to the leadership team by 2027-03-18. That means procurement + legal need to be able to review contract redlines by the week of 2027-03-15. If we can lock the MAP and get basic security evidence by 2027-03-08, that keeps us on track.

I reviewed the MAP — useful. A couple of asks: please add a milestone for a legal contract review window and a soft target for rollout readiness (not firm, just for planning).

Attachment: MedSaaS-Procurement-Questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah
Director of Platform Partnerships | MedSaaS Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap + suggested decision path and MAP draft

Tessa / Evelyn — I’ll take point on security artifacts. Plan:
- Share SOC2 excerpt (attached) and a 2-page controls summary tailored to PHI flows (network diagram + data handling notes).
- If Jamal needs an evidence package (e.g., penetration test reports), flag explicitly and I’ll coordinate with infra.

Proposed internal milestone dates (to match their timelines):
- Security evidence delivered: 2027-03-08
- MAP updated w/ legal window + procurement owner: 2027-03-05
- PoC kickoff (sandbox): 2027-03-22 (3-week window) — this lets them brief leadership by 03-18 and start the technical trial afterwards.

I’ll draft the controls summary by EOD tomorrow and attach.

—Ben
Security & Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <h.cole@medsaas.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Reed <j.reed@medsaas.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP (v2) + proposed milestone owners

Hannah — attaching MAP v2 with the legal review window and target owners populated. Highlights in the sheet:
- Milestone A: Security evidence delivered (Ben) — target 2027-03-08.
- Milestone B: Legal & procurement review window (Ken / procurement@medsaas.com) — suggested 2027-03-15 to 2027-03-19.
- Milestone C: PoC kickoff (Redwood / MedSaaS eng pairing) — 2027-03-22 (3 weeks).
- Milestone D: Exec recommendation to CFO (MedSaaS) — 2027-03-18 (soft).

A couple of operational notes:
- For the PoC we’ll provision a dedicated sandbox endpoint and provide a short SDK integration guide to speed initial requests.
- If Jamal requests on-site or additional non-standard evidence, that will likely add 1–2 weeks; please flag ASAP so we can align expectations with the CFO timeline.

Next steps for MedSaaS: confirm Ken as procurement owner and confirm whether Jamal wants an initial security sync call (Ben is available Thursday afternoon). Once confirmed we’ll finalize MAP v2 and open a shared Google Sheet for live milestone tracking.

Attachments: MedSaaS-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Jamal Reed <j.reed@medsaas.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP (v2) + proposed milestone owners

Thanks team — I reviewed the MAP v2. A couple quick clarifications from security:
- Please add a network diagram and a short dataflow that highlights PHI ingress/egress and any transformations.
- We’ll need encryption at rest details (KMS provider, key rotation) and proof of SOC2 controls mapping to our internal control IDs.
- I’d like a 30–45 minute technical sync (Ben + Redwood infra) before the PoC kickoff — Thursday 2027-03-10 at 10:00 PST works for me.

Procurement will handle contract redlines; Ken (procurement) will reach out separately. For now we are aligned on the 03-18 leadership recommendation target.

I’ll accept the MAP as-is for scheduling purposes but reserve the right to request follow-up evidence that could impact timeline.

—
Jamal Reed
Chief Information Security Officer | MedSaaS Health
